policy: new first-attempt entity answers on the same20 medium-pilot questions; cached original adjacency comparator, no retries/tools/fallback or outcome selection. Gold and arm names withheld from models.
metric: unchanged answer token F1, paired deltas and cluster95; abstentions. Diagnostic only, no product promotion.
limits: cached comparator generated earlier at two workers vs four now; execution date/model nondeterminism confound. All20 questions are previously exposed and are included in the new100-question retrieval evaluation; not a heldout answer test.
